headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when Christian Cage vs. Bryan Danielson clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.46 ? an excellent showing. Danielson and Cage clashed for the first time ever, with Danielson locking in the LeBell Lock before Ricky Starks' interfering title-belt shot let Cage steal the pin and retain.
Looking back to 2023, when Willie Mack was back in action after a long-awaited stretch away after just under 9 months away, appearing on Collision.

Looking back to 2023, when Kris Statlander vs. Skye Blue went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.71. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
